title: the external review pass's findings on lane H

findings.claim: with a kept tree in /opt/trialbox the bootstrap ran that tree's installer (box-install.sh or install.sh, and install.sh's tools before the switch), not the signed release's: the vendor key's signature did not cover the code that ran
findings.severity_basis: root code that IT's fingerprint check does not cover
findings.fix: the installer that runs is always the signed release's (ruling 7119913331): a kept tree that is not exactly this release gets the release brought in first by the signed tar's own host-tree module (the kept files set aside, the site's files kept), then the signed installer runs; an older bundle is never brought in; the rehearsal plants box-install.sh and install.sh
findings.from: the external review pass 7119643255 (integrator 7119659794, 7118926528), checked on master 8ddecb8d

findings.claim: the shell's sed -i rewrites of deploy/.env (install.sh, poc.sh, the GCP driver) rename a temp file but never fsync it

findings.fix: not in this card: listed

findings.claim: a kept tree's code outside what the bootstrap compared ran as root under the signed installer: a package folder at the top (shadowing a standard module) or a bytecode cache under the library folders; and the bytes checked were not the bytes used (no owner, mode or link-containment check on the signed files and their folders)
findings.severity_basis: root code the signature does not cover
findings.fix: the bootstrap counts any importable thing at the top that the release does not hold, removes the library folders' caches (never through a link; a linked cache folder counts), and counts a signed file that leaves the tree through a link or that it or a folder down to it is not owned by root alone; the folders above the tree must be root's or sticky

findings.claim: a PoC box's start warns, then runs a COMPOSE_FILE in a folder another user can write (settings_guard.sh compose-file-owner)
findings.severity_basis: root code from a file another user can change
findings.fix: a stop on every box, H-94 (1) (the integrator's ruling 7128436810); the install copies a compose file from outside the tree into deploy/site and starts only from there; the rehearsal's work dir is root's while the box runs

findings.claim: the install checked the override by name, then copied it by name

findings.claim: a plain site key another user owns passed the host check at mode 0600

findings.claim: a signal that ended poc.sh or install.sh while the ticker ran left the caller's pipe held
